notebooks.title: 约束堆叠与KKT核对
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, LinearConstraint

cells.code:
# Np3/Nu2，最后一输入保持；直接逐拍递推构造输出映射
Ad = np.array([[1.,1.],[0.,1.]])
Bd = np.array([.5,1.])
def predict(x,U):
    values = []
    for j in range(3):
        x = Ad@x+Bd*U[min(j,1)]
        values.append(x[0])
    return np.array(values)
G = np.column_stack([predict(np.zeros(2),np.eye(2)[i]) for i in range(2)])
free = predict(np.array([4.,1.]),np.zeros(2))
L = np.array([[1.,0.],[-1.,1.]])
Aineq = np.vstack([np.eye(2),-np.eye(2),L,-L,G,-G])
rhs = np.r_[np.full(4,2.),[1.5,1.,.5,1.],5-free,5+free]
H = 2*(G.T@G+.1*np.eye(2))
linear = 2*G.T@free
sol = minimize(lambda u:.5*u@H@u+linear@u,[-.5,-1.],jac=lambda u:H@u+linear,constraints=[LinearConstraint(Aineq,-np.inf,rhs)],method='SLSQP',options={'ftol':1e-10,'maxiter':200})
assert sol.success,sol.message
U = sol.x
lam = np.zeros(14)
lam[6:8] = np.linalg.solve(Aineq[6:8].T,-(H@U+linear))
slack = rhs-Aineq@U
assert np.min(slack)>-1e-8 and np.min(lam)>-1e-8
assert np.max(np.abs(H@U+linear+Aineq.T@lam))<1e-8
assert np.max(np.abs(lam*slack))<1e-7
print('default_G_free',G,free)
print('default_H_f',H,linear)
print('default_U_y_cost',U,free+G@U,np.sum((free+G@U)**2)+.1*(U@U))
print('default_rows_lambda',Aineq.shape,lam)

# 原KKT例与题3：下界必须写成负法向
for f,lower in [(np.array([3.,1.]),np.array([-2.,-2.])),(np.array([2.,-1.]),np.array([-1.,-2.]))]:
    u = np.maximum(-f,lower)
    multipliers = u+f
    assert np.all(multipliers>=0)
    assert np.allclose(multipliers*(u-lower),0)
    print('lower_bound_KKT',u,multipliers)
print('active_zero_multiplier_example','min .5*u^2 subject to u<=0: u=0, lambda=0')
L3 = np.eye(3)-np.eye(3,k=-1)
rate_rhs = np.r_[np.full(3,.5)+[.3,0,0],np.full(3,.5)-[.3,0,0]]
print('exercise1_L_rate_rhs_rows',L3,rate_rhs,(12,3))
print('valve_rate_example_pp_per_sample',100/30*1.)

notebooks.title: 有限软罚与可行性恢复
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog

cells.code:
# 二次罚不等于硬界；线性罚的阈值只针对本例
for V in [1.,10.,100.]:
    epsilon = 1/(1+V)
    u = 1+epsilon
    assert abs(2*(u-2)+2*V*epsilon)<1e-12
    print('quadratic_penalty',V,'u',u,'epsilon',epsilon)
for rho in [1.,2.,3.]:
    eps = max(0.,1-rho/2)
    print('linear_penalty',rho,'u',1+eps,'epsilon',eps)
# 所有性能行可软化，不代表硬物理界矛盾也能解决
contradiction = linprog([0.],A_ub=[[1.],[-1.]],b_ub=[1.,-2.],bounds=[(None,None)],method='highs')
assert contradiction.status==2
print('hard_contradiction_status',contradiction.status)

# 题4公共松弛：两拍输出都必须核对
# variables = [u0,u1,epsilon], hard inputs in [-1,1]
A = np.array([[1.,0.,-1.],[-1.,0.,-1.],[1.,1.,-1.],[-1.,-1.,-1.]])
b = np.array([-5.,15.,-7.,13.])
phase1 = linprog([0.,0.,1.],A_ub=A,b_ub=b,bounds=[(-1.,1.),(-1.,1.),(0.,None)],method='highs')
assert phase1.success
assert abs(phase1.x[2]-5)<1e-12
print('exercise4_min_common_slack',phase1.x)
print('exercise4_outputs',10+phase1.x[0],10+phase1.x[0]+phase1.x[1])
# 在无中间状态界、只有终端x_N=0时，|u|<=1的可达初态随N扩展
for N in [1,2,3]:print('terminal_reachability_interval',N,(-N,N))
print('reactor_rate_pp_per_sample_Ts_half',10*.5)
print('purity_slack_cap_pp',95-93)

notebooks.title: 双积分器的完整状态与输出约束
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.optimize import minimize, LinearConstraint, nnls

cells.code:
# 保留原40步主题，修正2Np状态堆叠和真实输出约束
Ts,Np,Nu = .1,15,5
Ad = np.array([[1.,Ts],[0.,1.]])
Bd = np.array([0.,Ts])
def rollout(x,U):
    values=[]
    for j in range(Np):
        x=Ad@x+Bd*U[min(j,Nu-1)]
        values.append(x.copy())
    return np.asarray(values).reshape(-1)
Phi = np.column_stack([rollout(np.zeros(2),np.eye(Nu)[j]) for j in range(Nu)])
Qbar = np.diag(np.tile([1.,.2],Np))
Gpos = Phi[::2]
L = np.eye(Nu)-np.eye(Nu,k=-1)
Aineq = np.vstack([np.eye(Nu),-np.eye(Nu),L,-L,Gpos,-Gpos])
H = 2*(Phi.T@Qbar@Phi+.1*np.eye(Nu))
states,inputs,plans = [np.array([5.,0.])],[],[]
previous,guess = 0.,np.zeros(Nu)
for k in range(40):
    free=rollout(states[-1],np.zeros(Nu))
    f=2*Phi.T@Qbar@free
    shift=np.r_[previous,np.zeros(Nu-1)]
    rhs=np.r_[np.full(2*Nu,2.),np.ones(Nu)+shift,np.ones(Nu)-shift,8-free[::2],8+free[::2]]
    result=minimize(lambda u:.5*u@H@u+f@u,guess,jac=lambda u:H@u+f,constraints=[LinearConstraint(Aineq,-np.inf,rhs)],method='SLSQP',options={'ftol':1e-11,'maxiter':300})
    assert result.success,result.message
    U=result.x
    slack=rhs-Aineq@U
    assert np.min(slack)>-1e-7
    active=np.flatnonzero(slack<1e-5)
    lam=np.zeros(len(rhs))
    if len(active):lam[active]=nnls(Aineq[active].T,-(H@U+f))[0]
    residual=max(np.max(np.abs(H@U+f+Aineq.T@lam)),np.max(np.abs(lam*slack)))
    assert residual<1e-4
    plans.append({'x':states[-1].tolist(),'previous':previous,'u':U.tolist(),'residual':residual})
    previous=U[0]
    inputs.append(previous)
    states.append(Ad@states[-1]+Bd*previous)
    guess=np.r_[U[1:],U[-1]]
states=np.array(states)
assert np.max(np.abs(states[1:,0]))<=8+1e-7
assert np.max(np.abs(inputs))<=2+1e-7
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(np.r_[0.,inputs])))<=1+1e-7
print('legacy_dimensions',Phi.shape,Aineq.shape)
print('legacy_last_sample',states[-1])
print('legacy_max_KKT_residual',max(p['residual'] for p in plans))

# 按真实时间轴画三轨迹，输入在采样后保持
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(9,7),sharex=True)
t=np.arange(41)*Ts
axes[0].plot(t,states[:,0])
axes[0].axhline(8,color='red',linestyle='--')
axes[0].axhline(-8,color='red',linestyle='--')
axes[0].set(ylabel='Position',ylim=(-8.5,8.5))
axes[1].plot(t,states[:,1])
axes[1].set(ylabel='Velocity',ylim=(-5,5))
axes[2].step(t,inputs+[inputs[-1]],where='post')
axes[2].set(ylabel='Input',xlabel='Time (s)',ylim=(-2.5,2.5),xlim=(0,4))
for ax in axes:ax.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print('legacy_executed_steps',len(inputs),'sample_interval',Ts)
